Dr. Van Zandt is a truly caring and educated professor with years of experience. She provides great and in-depth lectures to students with slides/examples on Canvas (take your own notes anyway).

Course is writing intensive (APA), has exams, and in-class discussions. Periodically lectures took place online and were great. Ask questions in person.
